fusions.name: Drop Anchor
fusions.desc: Drives a heavy anchor into an enemy that deals 16 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Hurl
fusions.desc: Hurls the anchor on its chain at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Staked Down
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Footing Held
fusions.desc: Each time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: you gain a shield worth 7% of your maximum health per stack, 28% in all at 4 stacks. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
